basis: Reference line PCE = 60 (Goljan, Fridrich and Filler 2009), fixed in advance and not tuned, with measurements from the SensorTrace VISION subset evaluation attached (13 smartphones from 2011-2016, camera-original JPEGs at native resolution, 40 flat-field reference images per device, one candidate per comparison). On the seven held-out devices: 0 false matches in 880 different-device comparisons (95% upper bound 0.42%) and 0 misses in 280 same-device comparisons (upper bound 1.3%). On all 13 devices: 0 false matches in 3,680 (upper bound 0.10%), 0 in 560 same-model comparisons (7 device pairs), and 7 misses in 520, all from one device. These thresholds are not calibrated and the measurements do not lift the same-model requirement: same-model evidence is one device pair for four of the five models (80 trials each, upper bound 4.5% per model) and firmware is not part of the model key. The non-match line of 10 is an engineering choice.
